name: Jennifer M. Mikulina
tagline: Top rated Intellectual Property attorney in Chicago, Illinois
about: Jennifer M. Mikulina is an attorney providing legal services covering Intellectual Property and Intellectual Property Litigation.

Jennifer Mikulina, who practices law in Chicago, Illinois, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2018 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at University of Wisconsin Law School. She graduated in 2001. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 2001.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
